title: Schedule of Dining Plan Calendar Terms: Start Day, Cutoffs, Commitment and Notice
content:
Schedule to the Dining Plan terms. These are the calendar figures that fix when a plan or a plan change starts, the cutoffs for changes and cancellations, the limits on changes, the minimum commitment, proration when a residency ends, and notice of fee increases.

| Plan | Day of the month plans and plan changes take effect | Day by which a plan change must be requested to take effect next month | Day by which a cancellation must be signed to end the plan at that month's end | Most plan changes in any rolling 12 months | Minimum months a plan must run before it can be cancelled or lowered | Plan fee prorated when the residency ends mid-month | Calendar days of written notice before a plan fee increase |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dining 10 Meal Plan | 1 | 20 | 20 | 4 | 0 | Yes | 30 |
| Dining 15 Meal Plan | 1 | 20 | 20 | 4 | 1 | Yes | 30 |
| Dining 30 Meal Plan | 1 | 20 | 20 | 4 | 1 | Yes | 30 |
| Dining 45 Meal Plan | 1 | 20 | 20 | 4 | 1 | Yes | 30 |
| Dining 60 Meal Plan | 1 | 20 | 20 | 4 | 1 | Yes | 30 |
| Dining Full Board Plan | 1 | 20 | 20 | 4 | 1 | Yes | 30 |

## Notes

1. Plans and plan changes take effect on the 1st of a month on every plan.
2. The change cutoff and the cancellation cutoff are both the 20th of the month on every plan.
3. The minimum commitment is the one figure in this schedule that differs between plans: 0 months on the Dining 10 Meal Plan, 1 month on each of the other five plans.
4. The figure for plan changes is a count within any rolling 12 months, and the notice figure is counted in calendar days.
